subject: Re: Kickoff: Agile Modeling — concept to classifier in minutes
body:
Dmitri,

Resourcing. Maren 60% on the pool pipeline, Vera 50% on the labeling loop, Linnea 50% on model training. We're pinning TensorFlow 2.13.0 to match the release; the Python version drift is the usual pain but manageable.

Compute: For the LAION-400M embedding precompute we hold the cirrus-tpu reservation for the week of 2026-07-06 — 128 accelerators — so the pool is ready well before the alpha. Titan covers everything else best-effort.

Ask: the LAION download and preprocessing (per the Demo.ipynb instructions) needs ~8TB of staging on Corpus — filing the quota this week. If quota slips, pool prep slips a week and the whole back half compresses.

Alina
